capabilities: Transcribe single images via command palette or context menu
Batch-transcribe folders of images with optional subfolders
Write .md files beside images or insert text into the note
Install, select, and remove Ollama models from the palette
Track batch progress with per-file status
disambiguation: Despite the name, it transcribes images (OCR) to Markdown, not audio recordings.
extras: Desktop-only; needs a running local Ollama server (default URL, Test button); detailed usage and troubleshooting are in an external user guide; one-time release-notes dialog after updates.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to extract text from images, and cloud OCR services would send vault content off the user's machine.
summary: Transcribes vault images to Markdown via local Ollama vision models, with single-image and batch folder modes and in-palette model management.
